# AURA EDGE — Phase 1 CPU vs GPU Voice Benchmarks

**Date:** 2026-11-25  
**Hardware:** Intel Core i7-13650HX (14P/20L cores), `15.78 GB` RAM, NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3050 6GB Laptop GPU (`6144 MiB` VRAM, Driver `621.24`), Windows 11.  
**Source Dataset:** `models/eval_audio/phase1_benchmarks.json` (generated by `backend/scripts/benchmark_phase1.py --trials 3`).  
**Note on Methodology:** All numbers below were measured directly on this machine with `HF_HUB_OFFLINE=1`, `strict_offline` network policy, `faster-whisper-small`, `sherpa-onnx 1.13.8` (`num_threads=4`), and `qwen3.5:4b` (`num_ctx=4096`). Cold runs measure the first uncached request (including model/cache initialization); warm metrics summarize 3 sequential warm trials.

---

## 1. Effective Hardware Placement

| Component | `cpu` Mode (`effective_mode="cpu"`) | `gpu` Mode (`effective_mode="gpu"`) | `auto` Mode |
|---|---|---|---|
| **Faster-Whisper `small` STT** | `cpu` (`int8`) | `cuda` (`int8_float16`) via retained `torch\lib` DLL handle | `cuda` when probe passes, else CPU `int8` with recorded `fallback_reason` |
| **Silero VAD v5 ONNX** | `cpu` | `cpu` (pinned to CPU to save VRAM) | `cpu` |
| **TTSRouter (`sherpa-onnx` Piper/MMS)** | `cpu` (`num_threads=4`) | `cpu` (pinned to CPU to avoid GPU context contention) | `cpu` |
| **Ollama `qwen3.5:4b` Fallback** | `cpu` (`num_gpu=0` explicitly passed) | `gpu` (`num_gpu=null`, GPU offload enabled) | `gpu` if CUDA available, else `cpu` |
| **Measured Process RSS After Run** | `1144.3 MB` | `1255.4 MB` | Mode-dependent |
| **Measured System VRAM Used** | `1504 MiB` / `6144 MiB` | `1987 MiB` / `6144 MiB` | Mode-dependent |

## 2. Tier-0 Deterministic Routing & Local Tool Latency (96 Utterances)

Measured across all `96` multilingual utterances (`32 en`, `32 hi`, `32 kn`) against live PostgreSQL `16.16`:

| Metric | Measured Result |
|---|---|
| **Deterministic Router Median Latency** | `0.38 ms` |
| **Deterministic Router p95 Latency** | `1.46 ms` |
| **Local Tool Execution Median Latency** (`DateTimeTool` / `TimerManager` + DB) | `0.03 ms` |
| **Local Tool Execution p95 Latency** (`INSERT`/`UPDATE` PostgreSQL timers) | `6.18 ms` |
| **Multilingual Intent Accuracy (EN / HI / KN)** | `100.0%` (`96 / 96`: EN `32/32`, HI `32/32`, KN `32/32`) |
| **Verified Action Success Rate** | `100.0%` |
| **Incorrect Action Rate (Unsupported / Refusal Guard)** | `0.0%` |

## 3. Speech Pipeline End-to-End Comparison: CPU vs GPU

End-to-end (`E2E`) benchmark measures recorded WAV audio (`phase1a_tts_{en,hi,kn}.wav`) -> Faster-Whisper `small` STT -> Tier-0 Router -> Tool execution -> uncached TTS synthesis (`time to synthesized WAV / audible response ready`).

### English (`en` — `faster-whisper-small` + Piper `en_US-lessac-medium`)

| Stage | CPU Cold | CPU Warm Median | CPU Warm p95 | GPU Cold | GPU Warm Median | GPU Warm p95 |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| **STT Latency** | `2439.59 ms` | `2483.19 ms` | `2552.72 ms` | `1400.74 ms` | `259.59 ms` | `327.03 ms` |
| **TTS Latency (uncached)** | `263.52 ms` | `202.96 ms` | — | `425.49 ms` | `241.38 ms` | — |
| **End-to-End Turn** | `4878.07 ms` | `2761.94 ms` | `2798.17 ms` | `3708.52 ms` | `494.01 ms` | `579.39 ms` |

### Hindi (`hi` — `faster-whisper-small` + Piper `hi_IN-rohan-medium`)

| Stage | CPU Cold | CPU Warm Median | CPU Warm p95 | GPU Cold | GPU Warm Median | GPU Warm p95 |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| **STT Latency** | `3090.15 ms` | `3560.80 ms` | `3977.88 ms` | `662.68 ms` | `687.72 ms` | `688.59 ms` |
| **TTS Latency (uncached)** | `368.70 ms` | `373.46 ms` | — | `515.92 ms` | `369.13 ms` | — |
| **End-to-End Turn** | `4466.14 ms` | `3950.08 ms` | `4339.37 ms` | `1187.79 ms` | `1031.02 ms` | `1079.20 ms` |

### Kannada (`kn` — `faster-whisper-small` + MMS-TTS `vits-mms-kan`)

| Stage | CPU Cold | CPU Warm Median | CPU Warm p95 | GPU Cold | GPU Warm Median | GPU Warm p95 |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| **STT Latency** | `17824.92 ms` | `20401.98 ms` | `21100.30 ms` | `3568.20 ms` | `3680.22 ms` | `3988.12 ms` |
| **TTS Latency (uncached)** | `1415.53 ms` | `1801.67 ms` | — | `1589.36 ms` | `1346.12 ms` | — |
| **End-to-End Turn** | `20191.81 ms` | `21839.40 ms` | `23067.94 ms` | `5162.35 ms` | `5015.23 ms` | `5339.22 ms` |

*Note: Kannada cold short-phrase HTTP synthesis (`"ಸಮಯ ಮುಗಿದಿದೆ"`) completed in `233.03 ms` over `POST /api/v1/voice/synthesize`; longer multi-clause synthesis averages `1.35s`–`1.80s`. With `TTSRouter` LRU caching enabled, repeated status/error/time-prefix phrases serve cached WAV bytes in `<1 ms`.*

## 4. Local LLM Fallback Comparison (`qwen3.5:4b`)

| Metric | CPU (`num_gpu=0`) | GPU (RTX 3050 6GB) — Co-resident w/ Whisper `small` | GPU (Phase 1A Isolated) |
|---|---|---|---|
| **Cold Call** | `8613.20 ms` | `1903.30 ms` | `6746.73 ms` |
| **Warm Call** | `2115.45 ms` | `1992.20 ms` | `861.19 ms` |
| **TTFT** | `648.81 ms` | `660.83 ms` | `280.66 ms` |
| **Throughput** | `9.57 tok/s` | `10.54 tok/s` | `41.43 tok/s` |

**Takeaway:** GPU placement speeds up warm English STT by **`9.57×`** (`2483 ms -> 259 ms`) and Hindi STT by **`5.18×`** (`3560 ms -> 687 ms`), keeping GPU end-to-end English/Hindi turns around **`0.5s`–`1.0s`**, while deterministic Hassil routing keeps `~95%+` of common time/date/timer turns off the LLM entirely (`0.38 ms` median).
